en: \bDr. Footstep: Can I rate your Pokémon for you?

\bDott. Impronta: Sarà per la prossima volta, allora.

en: \bDr. Footstep: Hmmm... Your \v[2] may not like you very much.

en: \bDr. Footstep: Your \v[2] is quite friendly to you! You must be a kind person!

en: \bDr. Footstep: Your \v[2] is super friendly to you! I'm a bit jealous!

en: \bDr. Footstep: I shall reward your \v[2] with a ribbon!
